comment:
Failed at step 2: vendor A's name is cut off at the top of its row and drawn over the row under it.

Fails against: From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 13 (Change Log: version 12 on 12 Nov 2026 by Milos Vasic, version 13 on 13 Nov 2026 by Chris Ward), read 13 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location) S5-R13 (version 13): “The customer chip (A/R) and vendor chip (A/P) and their open menus are the native ones: Customer exactly as Sales By Customer's Customer filter (person icon), Vendor exactly as Inventory Value's Vendor filter (truck icon, "Search vendors"; as there, the search box shows only when there are more than 8 vendors). The menu has a search box, an "All customers" or "All vendors" row, the native line "All customers are included. Pick one or more to narrow." (or vendors) while none is ticked, and the list; several can be ticked. The chip reads "Customer: All customers" or "Vendor: All vendors" in the resting (grey) style when none is ticked, the name when one is (shortened with "..." when long), and "Customer: N customers" or "Vendor: N vendors" when N are. The ticked customers or vendors narrow every row, group, total, page, sort and export; the Location list does not change (S5-R3).” From: Slack, Chris Ward (product owner), 13 Nov 2026, thread in channel C0C454MLP0T, read 13 Nov 2026 Slack, Chris Ward, Picture #1: “Picture #1 — the long customer name wrap issue (shows up in the filter)”

Fails against: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter" (Confluence 947650561, version 11, 5 Nov 2026), S3-R7a: "The PDF uses the app-wide report PDF format, the same as Sales By Customer and Inventory Value: a negative amount prints in brackets with a minus sign, for example "(-$11,111.00)", and dates print as "Nov 04 2026"."

Tested on QA site sv11315, build v26.45.2-6a8b89c, on 11 November 2026.

  • Set up: customer ZZX PDF Date S9 with one open invoice (S11315-17866, $64.00) dated Nov 4, 2026, due Dec 4, 2026; A/R Aging Detail with only that customer ticked.
  • Step 4: set As of to 11/04/2026, expand "Current", choose Download (PDF) from the ⋯ menu and read invoice A's row.
  • You see: the PDF row prints Date "Nov 4, 2026" and Due Date "Dec 4, 2026" - one-digit day and a comma.
  • The test says the PDF prints dates as three-letter month, two-digit day and year with no comma: "Nov 04 2026" and "Dec 04 2026".
  • For comparison, the Sales By Customer PDF on the same site prints its document dates as "Nov 04 2026", the form the requirement asks for.
  • The developer's handoff on the story (SV-11533) now says, corrected again on 11 Nov: the PDF should print dates as "Nov 04 2026"; the build printing "Nov 4, 2026" is the open defect SV-12544. Under the QA lead's ruling for this suite (follow the developer), this test is Failed again; the Passed recorded at ~14:00 UTC is replaced.

Follow the status here https://shopview.atlassian.net/browse/SV-12544 (In Progress, read 11 Nov 2026 ~14:33 UTC).

What needs to be done: nothing for the tester now; re-run this test once SV-12544 is fixed.
